goal_level_decision_audit.decision: Freeze Set A / Set B classification before the next full all-app pod run.
goal_level_decision_audit.different_path_now: Use a frozen two-number scorecard and require at least two focused material productized-path probes before spending full all-app pod time.
goal_level_decision_audit.foolish_actions: It would be foolish to run another full paired pod suite and classify rows after seeing results.
goal_level_decision_audit.other_path: Continue tuning routes and keep a blended geomean only. That would repeat the ambiguous 1.012x failure mode.
